en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a serene park landscape. In the foreground there is a small arched wooden pedestrian bridge with railings, leading to a winding path that curves through lush trees and shrubs. In the background, partially framed by trees, stands a small church with a tower and steep hipped roof, typical of Central European village churches. Low wooded hills rise behind the church.
